verdict.rationale: Spline documents its own export paths. Self-Hosted export packages an entire project, with all assets and the Spline runtime, as a self-contained ZIP. Code export produces Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js and react-three-fiber. These let a user take individual scenes off-platform, but the evidence never shows open interchange formats for scene data or a bulk export of all account data. The self-hosted bundle depends on the Spline runtime. Missing for 10: documented open 3D interchange formats (e.g. glTF/OBJ/USDZ), whole-account or bulk export of all files, confirmation that exported scene data is not tied to a proprietary runtime format, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving with full fidelity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Self-Hosted export option in Spline allows you to export your entire project, including all assets and the Spline runtime, as a fully self-contained ZIP file.
Spline allows you to export the code of your scene as: Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber
